Summarization API Playground

How It Works

This playground uses Chrome's built-in Summarization API powered by Gemini Nano, a compact AI model that runs entirely in your browser. No data is sent to external servers - all processing happens locally on your device.

  • Privacy-First: Your text never leaves your browser
  • Offline Capable: Works without an internet connection (after initial model download)
  • Real-Time: Instant summarization with automatic updates as you type
